queue.title: Add pure hit-stop config and helper to the combat layer
queue.rationale: Punchy-hits pillar. Shake, flash and sparks exist; hit-stop is absent (review.md section 4). A pure timing helper and config is small and testable. ArenaScene application is lead-owned and stays a follow-up.
acceptance: A hit-stop config and pure helper return a hit-stop duration in ms per hit type (light, heavy)
A test asserts the round timer state.tick keeps counting during hit-stop
npm test stays green
queue.notes: ArenaScene.js application is a lead follow-up, not edited here. Specific ms values are not in the GDD: use design/art/hit-feedback-spec.md values only if present, else expose as config.

queue.title: Rebind defence keys to the GDD: Dodge=L(alt C), Block=I(alt V), Parry=T(alt M) as separate actions
queue.rationale: Three contradicted values (dodge, parry, block) that break the defence-depth pillar. They share src/player/input.js and must change together because V and L/C swap roles. Bindings are stated in the GDD; parry reward behaviour is not (see the GAP-003 item).
acceptance: KEY_MAP maps L and C to dodge, I and V to block, T and M to parry
A parry press yields a parry guard without a block press
Existing input and state machine tests updated and npm test passes

queue.title: Make the Controls panel list the real key bindings
queue.rationale: Bug: the panel shows GDD bindings the code does not implement (block/dodge swapped, crouch/pickup/parry absent). After the rebind the panel should read from the real KEY_MAP so they cannot drift.
acceptance: A pure function derives controls panel rows from the player KEY_MAP (read-only import)
A test asserts every row matches an action present in KEY_MAP and no absent action is listed

queue.title: Finish single-source combat data: wire npm test and consumers
queue.rationale: Old GAP-009 is partially done: src/shared/combatData.js exports PLAYER_MOVE_COMBAT and GRUNT_ATTACK_COMBAT with src/shared/combatData.test.mjs (passes when run directly, 1/1). It is not run by npm test because package.json lists test files explicitly and no agent owns package.json. Step 2 (moves.js and gruntData.js importing the values) needs files outside combat-agent ownership, and the owner has not approved widening.
acceptance: src/shared/combatData.test.mjs is run by npm test
src/shared/combatData.js exports damage, hitbox, knockback and hitstun for every player move and grunt attack, confirmed by its test
queue.needsOwnerReason: Two approvals needed: (1) add src/shared/combatData.test.mjs to the package.json test script (package.json is unowned); (2) step 2 requires edits to src/player/moves.js (player-agent) and src/enemies/gruntData.js (encounter-agent). Suggested route without widening combat-agent: owner approves two separate follow-ups, one for player-agent and one for encounter-agent, each importing from combatData.js. Not widened here.

queue.title: Add a pure player animation-state selector mapped to declared asset keys
queue.rationale: Only a static placeholder SVG exists; zed.idle/walk/jump keys are declared but unused. A pure selector in src/player/ is testable; registering and playing animations lives in ArenaScene (lead).
acceptance: A module maps each player state to an animation key declared in assets/asset-keys.json
A test asserts no state maps to an undeclared key
ArenaScene playback is listed as a lead follow-up
queue.notes: Where a state has no declared key, the test should list it rather than invent keys.
